summary: Important: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: xen: AMD Zen 2 Processors: Privilege escalation via improper CPU cache isolation (CVE-2025-54518)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Kernel crash in bpf_for_each_array_elem() due to missing backport of upstream commit 4b6313cf99b0 (JIRA:Rocky Linux SIG Cloud-191844)

* gfs2: xfstests generic/363 failure [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux SIG Cloud-214099)

* Rocky Linux SIG Cloud8: HYPERV hv_storvsc driver can we add additional code to allow PERSISTENT_RESERVE_IN [Rocky Linux SIG Cloud 8.10Z]  (JIRA:Rocky Linux SIG Cloud-188270)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
